text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for Mejiro Dober's
senior-year
summer camp! She'll need to
pack on a lot more
power for the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this a good summer camp,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We'll make the most of this blistering
summer and
prepare for the fall racing
season!
